articles.headline: Pirelli and Balkrishna Strike India Tyre Production Deal
articles.brief: Pirelli and Balkrishna have joined forces to establish a major tyre production partnership in India, aiming to expand manufacturing capabilities and meet growing regional demand within the automotive supply chain.

articles.headline: India Permits Large Silver Imports Despite Weak Domestic Demand
articles.brief: Despite softening domestic demand, Indian authorities have authorized large-scale silver imports, signaling robust industrial appetite and strategic positioning by bullion traders amidst fluctuating global commodity markets.

articles.headline: Ambani's Record Jio Indian IPO Oversubscribed Five Times
articles.brief: Reliance Industries' Jio has seen unprecedented demand for its landmark Indian initial public offering, with institutional and retail subscriptions surging past five times the offered shares within days of opening.

articles.headline: Tech Mahindra Partners with SpaceXSI for AI Software Development
articles.brief: India's Tech Mahindra has forged a strategic partnership with SpaceXSI to leverage artificial intelligence for advanced software development, targeting enterprise efficiency and next-gen technological solutions.

articles.headline: Merck and Moderna Cancer Vaccine Cuts Melanoma Risk
articles.brief: A combined cancer vaccine developed by Merck and Moderna has demonstrated a 42% reduction in melanoma death or recurrence risk, though company share prices faced short-term volatility following the announcement.

articles.headline: India-EU Trade Deal Targeted for Early 2027 Operation
articles.brief: India's trade minister announced that ongoing negotiations for a comprehensive India-EU free trade agreement are progressing well, with the pact expected to become fully operational by early 2027.

articles.headline: At Least Sixteen Dead After 7.0 Earthquake Strikes Tibet
articles.brief: A powerful 7.0-magnitude earthquake hit a mountainous region of China's Tibet, leaving at least sixteen people dead and dozens injured, sparking emergency rescue operations across affected communities.

articles.headline: US Banks Detect Unauthorised AI Agents Accessing Accounts
articles.brief: Major US financial institutions, including JPMorgan Chase and Bank of America, have reportedly detected unauthorized artificial intelligence agents attempting to access customer accounts, prompting heightened security measures.

articles.headline: Nine Retired Generals in Diplomatic Roles Stir Pakistan
articles.brief: The appointment of nine retired military officers among non-career diplomats has placed Pakistan Army Chief Asim Munir's political influence and strategic personnel choices under intense domestic and international scrutiny.

articles.headline: US and Israel Prepare for Strategic Strikes on Iran
articles.brief: Military planners in the United States and Israel are reportedly preparing coordinated defense strategies and potential strikes against Iran following upcoming political cycles, as regional tensions continue to escalate.

articles.headline: Google CEO Rejects US Request to Rename Atlantic Ocean
articles.brief: Following administration requests, Google CEO Sundar Pichai formally declined a proposal to rename the Atlantic Ocean on Google Maps, explaining that digital geography standards cannot accommodate unilateral national alterations.

articles.headline: BrahMos Aerospace Eyes 1,500-Km Missile Variant by 2028
articles.brief: BrahMos Aerospace is scaling up global production capacity and advancing development on the next-generation BrahMos-NG missile, with a conceptual 1,500-kilometer strike variant currently under serious exploration.

articles.headline: Reserve Bank of India Signals Two More Rate Hikes
articles.brief: Minutes from the Reserve Bank of India's monetary policy committee indicate that persistent inflationary pressures may force policymakers to implement at least two more interest rate hikes in the near future.

articles.headline: Mark Zuckerberg Threatens California Exit Over Wealth Tax
articles.brief: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg has threatened to relocate operations outside California in response to a proposed five billion dollar billionaire tax, as Meta introduces new share classes to protect corporate governance.

articles.headline: Sonam Wangchuk Demands Full Statehood for Ladakh Region
articles.brief: Activist Sonam Wangchuk accused the central government of backtracking on prior commitments regarding autonomous governance, renewing strong public demands for full statehood and constitutional safeguards for Ladakh.
